description: Footpath steepness is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne open data portal (data.melbourne.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This shapefile contains the gradients of all City of Melbourne public footpaths. includes streets, laneways and park walkways. The gradients are expressed ion the distance of the section and the percentage gradient. Coverage: City of Melbourne, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. Its tags are accessibility, cityreactivation, eventsplanner, footpath, gradients. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2023-02-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
